meta.title: chore(shed): update trace-finding in lotus-shed miner fees & fees-inspect with a better top-down filter
meta.body_summary: Update lotus-shed miner fees commands with hierarchical trace filtering to follow expected cron execution flow, reducing noisy output by filtering irrelevant traces.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added depth-based trace filtering; rvagg suggested early-return refactor; PR merged after fix and two approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 106 changed lines in a single file, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, targeted optimization PR, and the merge after review is consistent with low-risk, narrowly-scoped changes.

review_details.concern_detail: rvagg noted the filtering logic wasn't quite right, suggesting to restructure to early returns and be more specific at depth 2.
review_details.performance_claim: Better top-down filtering reduces noisy output and processing time.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing hierarchical trace filtering requires understanding protocol flow and domain-specific actor interactions; Copilot successfully integrated depth-based checks but needed a minor refactor per maintainer feedback.

detection_detail.code_reading: rvagg reviewed the trace filtering logic, identified an inelegant pattern with validTrace variable, and suggested an early-return refactor.
detection_detail.ci_auto: github-actions bot enforced PR title convention, leading to title rename.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The change is a correctness/filtering optimization; no numerical performance metrics were provided or required.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After rvagg's suggestion, Copilot refactored the code to use early returns, and the PR was approved and merged.

core_change_summary.description: In cmd/lotus-shed/miner-fees.go, added depth-based switch-case filtering in printExec and traceBurns to only follow the expected cron execution path (System→Cron, Cron→Power, Power→Miner method 12). Refactored from validTrace variable to early returns after review.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: No secondary files; all changes in miner-fees.go
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added depth-based filtering with validTrace variable in printExec and traceBurns.
Review feedback: rvagg suggested removing validTrace and using early returns, and more specific depth 2 filter.
Refactor commit: implemented early returns, removed validTrace, and tightened depth 2 check (only Power→Miner method 12).

review_signals.summary: Filter logic incorrect; should use early returns and be more specific at depth 2 instead of validTrace.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot refactored as suggested and pushed commit.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed refactor to early returns and more specific depth 2 filtering.
DISMISSED review requesting PR title convention compliance.
